name: OSN LP dividend distribution drain
summary: The OSN token's transfer hook pushed USDT dividends to LP holders through its dividend tracker without any minimum LP holding time or contract-recipient check, so the attacker split funds across helper contracts, added liquidity, and immediately collected the accumulated reward pool.
